# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Glyph rendering hardening**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp 4.157.0 update improves mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads disagree.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Handle changing glyph paths and mask layouts** — Mask-filtered glyph rendering uses the reloaded glyph's own outline or raster image. Incompatible formats and non-overlapping bounds produce cleared output instead of unsafe copies or format assertions. Clipped embossed glyphs retain full plane strides, and clearing the full destination prevents leftover mask data. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
